STEP 2 - Vessel size:

b) Reference cue: the pizza slice is roughly 11-12 cm along its long edge, and the plate spans about 2.3 slice lengths across the visible width, giving roughly 26-27 cm.

STEP 3 - Food items:

- Roasted carrot pieces: about 8-10 chunks, roughly 1 cm thick slices, in a small cluster at the right edge. Footprint about 6% of plate area = 40 cm2. Thickness: one chunk about 1.5 cm, stacked about 2 deep at the thickest point, so average about 1.5 cm. Volume = 40 x 1.5 = 60 ml, bulk density 0.6 g/ml (chopped vegetables) gives about 36 g. Roasted carrots with a little oil, about 60 kcal/100 g (roughly 70 with oil; use 70).

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no base layer under the pizza or carrots; plate surface is otherwise empty. No extra items added.

STEP 5 - Energy:
- Pizza: 100 g x 270 kcal/100 g = 270 kcal
- Carrots: 36 g x 70 kcal/100 g = about 25 kcal

Total: about 136 g, about 295 kcal.
